name: Bug report

title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug

---

## Description

Describe the problem without including secrets, personal data, or private infrastructure details.

## Expected Behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual Behavior

What happened instead?

## Reproduction

Provide sanitized steps and environment information.

## Validation Evidence

Include only sanitized logs, screenshots, or other evidence.

## Security Check

If this could be a vulnerability, stop and use the private process in `SECURITY.md` instead of submitting this issue.
